course_summary:
ISEN 615 | Production and Inventory Control | Fall 2026
Instructor: Alaa Elwany | elwany@tamu.edu
Grading: Assignments [10%], Exams [90%] — A: [90,100], B: [80-90), C: [70,80), D: [50,70), F: [0,50)
Topics: kitting, MRP, just-in-time, flexible manufacturing, assembly, line balancing, lot sizing, dispatching, releasing, push production systems, pull production systems, deterministic operations scheduling problems, basic project scheduling problems, aggregate production planning, supply chain planning, fundamental inventory control systems, certain/uncertain demand, model development, production control models, inventory management, production planning, scheduling, analytical methods, operations management problems, production function, decision making in a production system
Tools: Canvas
Prerequisites: ISEN 620; ISEN 609
